description: This Java source file defines a REST API resource for managing client addresses within the Apache Fineract platform. It provides endpoints to get address templates, add new addresses, list addresses for a client, and update addresses. The class uses annotations for API documentation, request handling, and security, and interacts with underlying services to perform the operations.

classes.name: ClientAddressApiResource
classes.description: A REST controller providing endpoints for creating, retrieving, and updating client addresses in the Fineract platform.

methods.name: getAddressesTemplate
methods.description: Returns a template AddressData object for address creation.

methods.name: addClientAddress
methods.description: Creates a new address for a specific client based on provided address data and type.

methods.name: getAddresses
methods.description: Retrieves a list of addresses for a specific client, optionally filtered by status and address type.

methods.name: updateClientAddress
methods.description: Updates an existing address for a specific client with new data.
